findings.issue: Two separate מִן phrases (from the house, from the flesh) are fused as “desde la casa de la carne,” so the flesh modifies the house as a genitive instead of a second source/partitive “from.”
findings.spanishSpan: desde la casa de la carne

notes: Passive “se comerá,” 2ms “sacarás,” 2mp “quebrarán,” singular “hueso,” and “en él” match the tokens.
